name: Aminata Diallo
headline: 19, apprentice plasterer, Dakar
description: Aminata sells breakfast porridge at a construction site in the mornings and attends a government-run trade school in the afternoon. She is learning plastering and takes cellphone photos of every sample wall so she can compare her trowel strokes later. She rents a single room with two other apprentices and saves her wages in cash because she does not trust banks.
